details: The United States has imposed sanctions on Nobitex, Iran's biggest cryptocurrency exchange, alongside three other digital asset platforms. The Treasury Department accused Nobitex of enabling the Iranian government and blacklisted state institutions, including the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), to circumvent Western sanctions and transfer wealth out of the country. This action targets Iran's use of digital assets in a parallel financial system.
title: US Sanctions Iran's Largest Crypto Exchange

details: The US Special Presidential Envoy Steven Witkoff met with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi in Muscat, Oman, marking the most significant direct diplomatic engagement between Washington and Tehran in years. Both sides reportedly agreed to reconvene. These talks aim to address persistent differences, occurring while Iran is reportedly increasing its use of digital assets to bypass US sanctions.
title: US, Iran Hold Diplomatic Talks in Oman
